description: Draft a cold DM to a founder, grounded in which tracked investors moved on the company and any verified shared connection. Writes only - this NEVER sends anything and holds no permission to. The returned grounded_in block lists every fact the draft was allowed to claim, so a human can check each one before sending. If grounded_in.warm_angle is null the draft will not imply a shared connection, because a fabricated mutual is checkable in one tap and costs the sender the meeting. Show the user the draft and let them send it themselves.

angle.description: Steer the draft, e.g. "lead with the infra angle"

founder.description: Founder X handle (without @). Improves the draft and enables the warm-path angle.

founder_bio.description: Founder bio, for a specific reference

founder_name.description: Founder display name, for the greeting

funding_context.description: Anything known about their funding, e.g. "no round announced"

sender.description: Who the DM is from. Without this the draft uses placeholders.

name: frontrun_draft_dm
